description.text: Teaching Objective Master in Applied Economics Program for International Students (MEPIS) is a specially designed international program (English）partly based on the exiting master programs in applied economics at the School of Economics. This master program is targeted to train the master candidates in a variety of economic studies in economic development, industrial organization, international trade, investment, financial innovation, resources and environmental economics, and financial management. Educational Requirements 1. Well understand the deep theories and ongoing policy issues concerning economics and keep updated along with their advancement; 2. Built an independent thinking ability on economic theories and their applications; 3. Create strong potentials to communicate with governments, firms, NGOs and team members; 4. Write research papers, be capable in conducting seminars and working activities; 5. Apply fluent Chinese as a working language in doing business in China 6. Have the technique to conduct international business management and develop career potentials. Major Course Microeconomics International Economics International Marketing Chinese Business Culture Macroeconomics Investment Decision-Making Quantitative Economics Industrial Organization Advanced International Business International Financial Management Special Topics on Chinese Economy Duration 2-3 academic years

duration.text: The Applied Economics at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3750 USD/per year ￥ 27000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passpor With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photoz A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese 2. The people who haven’t broken laws 3. Have bachelor degree.
